rows.line: Ranta! Don’t wander off too far!
That line you saw is something anyone who’s gained some experience will have seen once or twice—or felt, rather. That might be the more correct way to describe it.
Sometimes I see it, sometimes I don’t. It’s not something you can see by focusing, after all.
That’s not a bad sign,
However, don’t misunderstand. It’s nothing special,
Thanks...!
Hungh...!
Next...!
Haru!
Huh?! Wh-What...?!
What do you mean, ‘What...?!’
Six...
Thanks...!
—Ah. Five,
Why, you...!
Anger!
—Wait, it’s four now!
Moguzo, take the foreman! Ranta, one of the followers is yours! Take it out as quick as you can! For the other two, Yume and I will manage them for now...!
Hatred...!
I can do something, too!
Ngh...!
Ohm, rel, ect, palam, darsh!
Yume!
Yikes!
Meow, meow, meow, meow, meow!
Why, you...!
Ungh...!
Thanks...!
Yeah! Got my vice...! Mwahahahaha...!
Augh! What’re you doin’? Yume coulda handled that one by herself!
What? You wanted to kill it yourself? Hah! You may have tiny tits, but you’re a bloodthirsty wolf, you know that? Are you going to convert and start worshiping Lord Skullhell like me now? Hmm?
—Yume, you mean solo combat.
It just goes to show, girls with tiny tits can’t do anything! If you don’t like that, make ’em bigger!
You say that, but Yume, she doesn’t know how to make her breasts get bigger!
Huh?! You do this...
You’re terrible.
Damn straight!

I’m fine with being a harasser! And fine with being terrible! Keep it coming! Don’t think you’ll make me back down with just that! If that’s what you’re going to call me, I’m gonna become the terrible king of sexual harassers!
Bwuh!
I-I don’t think you should do that in front of other people...
Huh? Does it work better if Yume does it when no one’s around?
Your pitifully tiny tits ain’t big enough to squeeze anyway, so you don’t need to worry about it. Gwahaha!
Augh! Ranta, you dummy!
I’m no dummy! I’m the terrible king of sexual harassers! Freshly crowned! Revere me!
Don’t get so stubborn...
Huh? What’s your problem?
You got something to complain about?
Huh?
About you, Haruhiro,
Man, I think you’re misunderstanding something.
Misunderstanding? Huh...? What’re you on about?
In other words, it’s like this. I hope you don’t want to be a hero or something like that, do you?
A hero?
Earlier...
...the way you were moving was weird, man.

No, seriously. It was strange. If I were to go further, I’d say you were the only one acting strange. It was like you were going at a slower pace, I could say. Maybe that’s not it. That’s not quite how I’d describe it. Or maybe it is. Well, either way, doesn’t matter. I know what you were up to. You were trying to take them down with one blow, weren’t you?
It’s not like you, Haruhiro, you know that? Hmm? You ought to know your place. Okay?
All’s well that ends well.
Sometimes I see it, sometimes I don’t. It’s not something you can see by focusing, after all.
Haru?
Huh?
Wh-What? Huh? I-Is something up...?
I should ask you the same,
Worried about something?
It’s nothing,
I see. Well, that’s good, then.
...Haruhiro-kun?
Is something up?
...Are you going somewhere?
Huh? I’m not going anywhere. Just... outside... to get some fresh air?
...Okay.
Yeah. Moguzo, you must be tired. You sound it at least. You should sleep. Good night.
Good night.
Choco?
Is something up?
...Choco?
Yes?
Uh, hey.
...If you’re here, you must be a volunteer soldier, too, right? Did you need something from us?’
...Choco,
It’s a coincidence... right?
—Heyyyyyy! Waaaaake uuuuuup!
Gwah?!
...Wh-What was that for, out of nowhere?! What the hell, man! Don’t do that! I can only tolerate so much of your crap!
Huhhh? What’re you so mad about, Haruhiro?
You were sleeping the day away, so I decided to be a nice guy and gently wake you up, you know?
I couldn’t get to sleep last night! Is there something wrong with that?!
Yeah, there is! That’s why I’m saying something about it, duh!
What could possibly be wrong with it?!
When I went to the trouble of rushing back here to give you the extra special info I heard, you were snoring like a baby, that’s what’s wrong!

Shove off, Moguzo! You just stay quiet! This is between me and Haruhiro! Until it’s settled, neither of us can move on! This is about setting things right between us, as men! Hey, Haruhiro! Right here, right now, we’ll settle this!
...Settle what?
Huh?! You know what! That thing! Uh, basically... What was it again?
How should I know?
—So,
What’s this extra special info?
Right, that!

You didn’t wake up at the usual time, and Moguzo said something stupid about waiting and letting you wake up on your own, so there I was, feeling real hungry, and so I went to the bakery. Yeah, the bakery. You know where I mean? Tattan’s Bakery, just outside of West Town. Well, when I did, there were a bunch of volunteer soldiers there. They were talking about it. Now, I’ll bet you want to ask what ‘it’ was, right? Well, hold your horses. There’s a proper order, a sequence, to all this. It’s like that in dating, too, isn’t it? Oh, maybe it’s too soon for you to understand that. You’re still just a little kid, after all. I mean, it’s pretty obvious that you’re still a virgin. Not me, of course. I’m the king of the old in and out. It’s like they say, experienced candidates receive preferential treatment. You get me? With my incredible technique, I leave those she-cats in an ecstatic frenzy.
...Okay, could you just let me know how long I’ll need to listen to your nonsense before you get to the point?
It’s not nonsense,
So, what’s the extra special info?
Before that, man, get down here. It’s extremely unpleasant having to look up to talk to a guy who I feel is beneath me.
How about you try dying then? Huh?
...Man, you whine about every little thing,
Huh? Did you just say something?
Yeah, I did,
I said you’re a like a pesky insect. Ah. Sorry. That’s not it. I said you are a pesky insect.
You dolt! I’m not a pesky insect, I’m a beneficial one!
What, you don’t mind being an insect?
Huh...?
So? What’s the extra special info?
—Hold on, how many times am I going to have to ask that same question before I get an answer?
Don’t try to get things without working for them,
I sound like an old man now!
You get it, Moguzo. Unlike Haruhiro here. You get what makes a gag funny. Haruhiro’s hopeless. He doesn’t get a thing. He doesn’t have a single funny bone in his body!
So? What’s the extra special info?
You’re repeating yourself, Haruhiro-kuuuun,
So? What’s the extra special info?
Oh! There it is again! You’re trying hard now.
Out with it!
Tell me! Just say it already! While I’m still holding back!
Y-You’re not holding back...! Ow! That hurts! Sto— Are you trying to kill me?! Fine! I’ll talk! I’ll talk, okay! Okay?! It’s an order! There’s an order!
An order...?
No, it’s nothing to be sorry for,
You can’t stop yourself from getting hungry. Look, we just so happen to have some bread here, so why not eat?
I bought that, and you know it!
At Tattan’s Bakery, the cheap place near West Town! I bought the bread, so it’s all mine!
—Yum...! This’s the stuff! It’s so good! Soruzo’s awesome!
Oh, come on, you’re exaggerating... Also, your nose is running, Ranta,
Of course it’s running! It’s gonna run like crazy! Haruhiro! Don’t you get it?! This soruzo, it’s perfect!
S-Soruzo’s delicious, huh,
...Moguzo, correct me if I’m wrong, but is that your second—No, third, bowl?
Y-Yeah. It’s easy to eat, you know, so I just keep wolfing it down faster and faster...
Gwahahaha!
Nice work, Moguzo! You’re not my rival for nothing! But... I’m going for it, too! On to the second bowl! Pops! Hit me with another one!
Coming up!
Well, it’s fine if you want to...
Still, though, Moguzo, this is delicious and all,
but, you know what? If we tried to make it ourselves, I bet we could, don’t you think? Well?
No, man, we could do it,
This stuff is easy. You just throw a bunch of ingredients in a pot. Just boil that, and it’ll come out tasting all right, I’m sure.
No... I don’t think it’s that simple... You know?
You think? It feels like we could pull it off. What’s in this soup?
Oh? Good job figuring all that out, Moguzo. Me, I had no clue, you know?
...I’m amazed you said you could make it, then,
...Yeah. If you add garlic, and maybe ginger... It might give it a more satisfying flavor.
Ohh? Ohhh?!
Moguzo, buddy, we could do it, don’t you think? Once we make some money, what say you and me open a restaurant?!
Buddy, don’t sweat the small stuff like that!

If we’re bringing in money, it doesn’t matter what job we’re doing. Besides, it’s not like we can stay in that violent world for the rest of our lives. Eventually, we’ll retire, and then we’ll need to start a second career. You know what that is? A second career. It’s a second, uh, you know. What is it? Um, it’s a second... career, yeah.
You just said the same thing again,

Shut up, Haruhiro. Just shut up. Seriously. Seriously. You can get lost! I’m having an important talk with Moguzo here! Anyway, how about it, Moguzo? Want to do that with me? Ranta and Moguzo’s Soruzo Shop. We’ll split the profits seventy to me, thirty to you... is what I’d like to say, but I’m fine with splitting it fifty-fifty. We’ll start studying now, so we’ll be ready when the time comes. How about it? Hm?
A restaurant, huh?

Yeah! You think about it! Be super positive about it! We’re gonna make so much money! Hand over fist! We’ll open a whole chain of restaurants! First, we start with ten locations in Alterna! Our goal will be 1,700 across all of Grimgar! You and I could do it, too! Well, that’s a long way off, though!
—So! Finally, I think it’s time for me to talk about the order! Are you mentally prepared? Am I good to start? I am, right? Don’t you tell me otherwise at this late stage of the game.
You’re being seriously annoying, so just tell us already...
Haaaaruhiroooo! When you call people annoying, you’re being one hundred! Nay! One thousand, ten thousand, no, no, no, five hundred million times as annoying! Get that through your head already!
You only need to say ‘yeah’ one hundred times,
Yeah—Wait, not one time, one hundred times?! That’s too many!
Don’t underestimate me! Brilliantly surprising people is what I, Ranta-sama, do!
...Even Moguzo’s laughing,
S-Sorry,

Mooooguzoooo! What do you mean ‘that one’?! It’s not just that one, it’s all the ones! I’m always funny! The wandering comedian king, Rantaman, that’s what they call me! If you doubt my one-in-a-hundred sense of humor, even if you are my future business partner, I’m not going to be able to forgive you!
One-in-a-hundred?
That doesn’t feel like anything special to me.
Haaaaruhiiiiro-kuuuun...
...What’s with that way of saying my name? It’s kind of creepy.
I meant to say one-in-a-hundred-million, but I accidentally only said one-in-a-hundred, yeeees. Do you get it noooow?
That’s your fault!
Don’t try to turn this on me, like I’m the bad guy...
You are the bad guy!
Enough already, just talk! What is it, this current order?!
Mwahahahahaha! Don’t let this shock you, okay?!
It’s this!
...No, there’s no way I’m going to be able to figure it out from that,
It’s a two-headed snake!

The operation to retake Deadhead Watching Keep and Riverside Iron Fortress, code name: ‘two-headed snake’! Participating in this operation, let it be no secret, is the order! Well, the deadline for going to Riversides’s already passed, and they say that one’s a job for experienced teams, so if we’re going to take part, it’ll be Deadhead we go to. The upfront pay is 20 silver, with 80 more on completion, making one gold altogether! That’s a solid gold coin! And that’s for each of us, you know?! That’s incredible!
One gold coin...
Consolation money. Take it.
Now, Deadhead,
is here.
...No, maybe here? Maybe around here? Or could it be around here?
Won’t any spot do?

Well, yeah. But, you know. It’s an orc fortress 6 km north of Alterna. When I say 6 km, that sounds pretty close. Or, rather, it is really close. Of course, our Frontier Army has attacked the fortress many times, and even taken it in the past. However, they can never hold it long. Why do you think that is?

Riverside Iron Fortress. This fortress, it’s about 40 km west of Deadhead, on the bank of a jet river, and if you go further upstream, you’ll run into the territory of the former Kingdom of Nananka. You know what that is? No, I bet you don’t. The former Kingdom of Nananka. It means orcs, man, orcs. Nowadays, there’s a country full of orcs there. So, they’re able to travel by boat and carry in supplies and troops. Deadhead’s a teeny-tiny little keep, but when the Frontier Army attacks, they raise smoke signals, or something. When they do that, reinforcements get sent in from Riverside immediately.
The orcish army’s got what they call dragoons,
They’re called dragoons, but they don’t ride dragons, they ride these huge lizards,
The big lizards are called horse-dragons. They’re crazy fast, and they can make the trek from Riverside to Deadhead in as little as an hour.
Is that why we’re doing both at the same time?
...Dammit,
Curse you, dry skin.
Don’t try to blame your skin...
Don’t butt in on everything, even me blaming my skin! What are you, my mother-in-law?!
So, moving on... Where were we?
Ignoring me, huh?! You’ve got guts, pal!
Riverside Iron Fortress, was it?
And Deadhead Watching Keep, they’re attacking them together... Wait, somehow, that almost seems like a war, don’t you think?
...Tch. You just insist on ignoring me. Haruhiro, didn’t you know? We humans have been at war with the orcs, the undead, and more, all this time.
Well, I had a sort of vague sense of that. But we didn’t seem to be going at it that hard, you know.
When the chance comes along, we go at it hard,
Not that long ago, a bunch of orcs fought their way into Alterna, remember?

Yeah, that’s it. Apparently, this got started as revenge for that. That was what got it going. And so, if we’re going to do it, rather than just harass them, we might as well take the whole fortress good and proper, that’s my thinking. We’ve taken Deadhead a number of times in the past, but they always take it back from us in no time. It’s Riverside that’s to blame for that. So, we’re not making the same mistake again.
The Frontier Army’s learned from their mistakes, wahahaha,
...Isn’t it kinda dangerous?
And, hold on, we’re not attacking with just volunteer soldiers... there’s no way that’d be it, right?
The volunteer soldiers are there in a supporting role, of course. Try to think a little. Are you a moron? Don’t just keep looking at it with sleepy eyes like that, Haruhirion.
Don’t talk about my eyes. I’ll stab you from behind. Also, drop the Haruhirion thing.
Numbers?

Let’s see, at Deadhead there’ll be five hundred or six hundred from the Frontier Army, they were saying. As for volunteer soldiers, it was one hundred, maybe a hundred and fifty. Riverside’s one tough fortress, so I expect it’ll turn into a pretty intense battle. I hear Soma’s Day Breakers, ‘Red Devil’ Ducky’s Berserkers, ‘One-on-One’ Max’s Iron Knuckle, and Shinohara’s Orion will be participating there. Honestly, that’s some crazy stuff. ‘If you aren’t confident in your skills,’ it feels like they’re saying, ‘if you come, you’re gonna die, so don’t come, you’ll only get in the way.’
So, there you have it.

One gold coin! We’ve gotta do it, with that up for grabs! It’s decided! Yup! Let’s go and apply already! There’re three days left before the deadline, but you know that proverb about striking while the iron’s hot, right? Or was it an idiom? Well, whichever, it’s a thing they say, and I say I’ll go to the office right now and—
Y-You can’t do that,
...W-We’ve got to let everyone else weigh in on it first...
You can’t be right about that...
Well, I’ll bring it up with them tonight, and we can make a decision after that. There’s still time, so it should be fine.
Oh, fine, if you insist.
Well, m-me, too, then,
I’ll get mead,
Ah, me, too,
Yume thinks she’ll go with lemonade. It’s so bubbly and delicious.
Okay, everyone got theirs?! Good work today! Cheers...!
G-Good work today!
Good work,
Good work, everyone,
Good worky-worky-work,
...Good work,
—Bwahh! I... win...!
Moguzo! How do you like that? I won! Wahahahahahahahahahaha!
Uh... sure,
Y-You’re amazing, Ranta-kun. Drinking it all in one go like that.
I know, right? I am awesome, aren’t I? You really do get it, Moguzo,
I should’ve expected no less from my future business partner.
Blinking partner?
What’s wrong, Shihoru?
...I-It’s nothing... Nothing, really...
Oh, yeah,
Shihoru. I’ll bet you were imagining something weird.
...S-Something weird...?
I don’t know what it’d have been. I’m not equipped with a delusion engine as powerful as yours, you know?
I-I don’t have an engine like that...!
So, that means I don’t have the same delusion energy coursing through me that you do, get it?
It’s not coursing through me...!
That’s some nasty accusation, Ranta!
Shihoru’s not like that. She doesn’t have no delugin’ apogee, or whatever weird thing you said, got it!
...You got the words wrong, though,
Whuh?! Did Yume goof it up again?!
Your words are wrong way too often, you know that! It drives the people listening to you crazy, so don’t talk for a while! Shut up!
Nuh-uh, no way!
You don’t get the right to refuse here!
Yume has her own opinion, too!
No one said anything about you having an opinion or not!
Ranta, you did!
I said you don’t have the right to refuse! Right! To! Re-fuse! You know what that is?! The right to refuse!
Yume knows that much!
Yeah, well, before we talk about what you do or don’t know, stop getting words wrong so often! Do you have holes for ears?!
Ranta.
Yep, they’re there. Holes in my ears. Everyone has holes for ears. Or are you blind? Do you have holes for eyes?
Huh...?
You’re the last one I want to hear that from...
If you don’t want to hear it, then don’t act in a way that makes me say it, huh? Show some restraint, okay?
...Hey, Moguzo,
Listen, just a friendly word of warning, but if you’re planning to run a business with this piece of shit in the future, you really ought to reconsider. There’s no way it’ll be a success.
A business?
Ohhh.
...So, once they’ve saved up some money and retired from being volunteer soldiers, Ranta suggested to Moguzo that they open up a soruzo shop together, you see.
Ramen—Wait...
What was that again?
Whut?
Ramen is... Um... Huh? That’s odd. Yume, did she know it... from somewhere? Maybe? What was it again? Huh? What was Yume talking about with everyone again?
...What were we talking about?
About ramen,

We were talking about ramen. We... We probably know what ramen is. That’s right. Soruzo, it’s kind of like ramen. When I first ate it, I thought it tasted like something. It was ramen I was thinking of. I couldn’t remember it at the time. I wonder why not. I’ve always loved ramen. Ranta-kun.
Huh? Oh...?
Someday, let’s do it. Open a restaurant.
Huh?
Yeah! You’ll be in charge of the cooking and raising capital! Leave everything else to me! I swear I’ll lead us to success!
Yeah!
...The cooking is fine, but raising capital, too...?
By the way, since everyone’s here, I had something I wanted to talk about,
Hell! Yeah!
We’ve gotta do it! That goes without saying, I mean! It’s a gold coin! Golden work! Not doing it isn’t an option! What’re we gonna do if we don’t?!
Yume, yeah,
She doesn’t care either way, maybe?
...Oh. Is that right?
Hm? What?
Oh, it’s nothing.
I’d like to try it... maybe?
Moguzoooo!
Yeah!
Y-Yeah...?
Get over here! Say, yeah! Yeah!
...Y-Yeah?
Yeah,
Yeah,

Wahahahaha! Seriously! Seriously! That’s my future business partner for you! We’re both frontliners, too! It’s no exaggeration to call him my partner! We’re like peas in a pod, Moguzo! Don’t you think so?! You do, right?!
Ah! Er, yeah. Y-You’re right. Hahaha...
Good, good, good, good! Hey, Haruhiro!
Huh? Wh-What?
No...
Ah—
Let’s do it tomorrow,
Huhhhhhhhhh...?!
What do you mean tomorrow, you idiot?! Don’t put off until tomorrow what can be done today! Are you a sloth?!
...It’s fine,
We don’t have to rush. There’s still time before the deadline. We can take a day to think it over properly, and it still won’t be too late to decide then.
Yume agrees with Merry, maybe. It should be fine, no?
Yeah, you’re right. It’s fine. There’s no rush.
You people...!
...I’m not so good at doing this kind of stuff,
We can do this, we can do this,
Ah,
...Hey,
Ha... Hahaha...
Wait,
Huh?
...What?
W-Well... You know. What is it...? Well... Um, nothing... Really.
Ah, okay,
Y-Yeah.
Huh?
Huh?!
Seriously, what?
Wh-What? What... I wonder what,
You’re weird.
Ah—weird? Am I weird, you think...?
Weird,
And gross.
No way?!
What is it?
What are you doing here?
Me? I’m not... doing anything weird, you know? Just being normal, and, well... thinking about some stuff, you could say...
What about you, Choco?
...What, no honorific for me?
S-Sorry. It’s just—
Are you,
a ladies man? You don’t look like it, though.
...I’m not, okay?
I’m exactly what I look like. I’m not. I’m not a ladies man at all. Umm, uh—Choco...chan? San?
Ah. Really?
Yeah,
Somehow...
Somehow, what?
...This is going to sound weird, but somehow—You know what, never mind.
Huh? Tell me,
You’ve got me wondering.
So you’re fine with it,
Huh?! No, I’m not really fine with it. But you said you wouldn’t tell me.
You weak-willed wussy.
You weak-willed wussy.
Choco,
Yes?
I’ll bet you don’t remember either, do you? What it was like before you came here.
Yep,
So, on that note,
could it be... Like, for me, I joined a party, and I think I met them all for the first time here, but maybe that’s not the case, right?
...You might have known each other from before?
Well, I’m just saying that it’s a possibility.
...you, too,
Yeah?
That’s not...
Come to think of it, I haven’t asked your name yet,
My name?
Ah... Yeah, that’s right, isn’t it?
I’m Haruhiro,
Haruhiro...
...Hmm. Well, can I call you Hiro?
Sure.
I’m okay with that,
Of course.
...Are you okay?
Huh? What do you mean?
I’m fine, you know?
Better hit the hay. ...What are you up to, Choco? It’s pretty late.
A walk, outside,
Can’t sleep?
Choco, you’re a thief?
...How could you tell?
I can tell by your equipment, and such. I’m a thief, too, after all.
Ah. You look like one,
Huh? What part of me?
You’re lanky.
No, that may be true, but... I’m a thief because I’m lanky? Is that the image you have? Is that what thieves are like to you? Why did you become a thief?
Going with the flow?
Something like that.
What’s your trade name?
The one we only use with other thieves?
...I kind of don’t want to say,
No, well, I’m not that fond of mine, either...
It’s something someone else gave me, anyway,
Well then, how about we both say them at the same time?
The same time?
Okay,
All right. One, two, three... Go!
Wh-What? What is it?
I mean, come on, Old Cat?
I probably got mine because of my eyes, too,
Because they look cheeky? Not because you act that way, too?
And wait, we’re both cats,
That’s some coincidence,
It really is...
Is your mentor Barbara-sensei?
Who’s Barbara?
Hmm,
Is your mentor a man?
Yeah. He’s scary.
Barbara-sensei, too,
I should never have become a thief,
I hear it’s hard at the other places, too, though,
There are thorns on every path?
I’d say so.
I want to take it easy,
Do you find it all a pain?
Yeah,
Hey,
Huh?
Hiro, is your party accepting the order, too?
The order... Wait, ‘too’? Choco, your party’s participating? In that operation...?
The subject is whether or not we participate in the order for Operation ‘Two-Headed Snake.’ All in favor, raise your hands.
Yeah!
...Huh,
...Hoh,
...Huh?
Hm?
One, two, three, four, five... Five?!
No, Ranta, you just counted both of your hands,
Huhh?! I did not! Like I’d do that! No, wait, maybe I did. Yeah, I did. So, what then, it’s four? Four. That’s a majority, huh.
Yeah, it kind of is,
So, that settles it. We’ll accept the order.
R-Right,
What?
That’s what we voted. There shouldn’t be a problem.
I don’t have a problem with it.... But, wait! Haruhiro! You’re in favor?! What’s brought this up?!
Not ‘up.’ You mean ‘on,’ right?

Shut up! You’re such a pain! It doesn’t matter, really! You’re a coward to the core, so if you’re voting in favor, what are you plotting—No, don’t tell me! I’ve got it! I’ve got you figured out! I’ll bet it was clear that you’d lose the vote even if you voted against, so you figured it’d rock the boat less if you voted in favor, or something lame like that! Bullseye, right?! That’s so like you!
...Don’t just decide that,
That’s not what I’m thinking at all. Besides, if I hadn’t approved, we wouldn’t have had a majority.
What are you, a magnifying glass?
You’re too imprecise.
I don’t sweat the small stuff, so call me magnanimous!
It means kingly! Because I’m fit to be a king!
—Well, what, then?! Haruhiro! What did you vote in favor for?! Spill your guts! Come on, puke!
...Yeah... His very existence is...
I’d like to know...
